annotations.text:
The default explorer. One tag, its own store. Docked and overlay are the same components in two layouts; the theme chip above each board switches the same tokens between light and dark.
States and the lasso flow below.

Host 1 · Ops console (geo)
Customisation: mid. Docked explorer; basemap slotted under the map; their facet rail is our filter elements restyled; their incident card replaces the item card. Tokens: dark, amber, Barlow + JetBrains Mono, 2px radii.

Host 2 · Image dataset curator (ML)
Customisation: heavy. No explorer — pieces in their own grid. Tooltip slot shows a thumbnail; item card and selection panel are theirs, fed from the store. Lasso → queue for labelling, with the sample and the set both named.

Host 3 · Document research desk
Customisation: mid. Search-first app; the header search box is a tessera-filter on title. Results list and document preview are theirs; the map is one view among tabs. Warm serif tokens.

Host 4 · Editorial drop-in
Customisation: minimal. One tag in an article column, panels="legend", a dozen tokens: the page's serif, one green, no radii, no shadow. Tests the narrow container.

Host 5 · Notebook
Customisation: none. tesseradb.Map in a cell at cell width; the same docked explorer with a narrower sidebar. The next cells read the selection back into Python. The token never enters the notebook.
